title: Water Service Line Material Inventory
description: Water Service Line Material Inventory in Sandy City, Utah. The upstream service publishes no description for this layer. Published by Sandy City to meet the service line inventory requirement of the US EPA Lead and Copper Rule Revisions. The inventory is incomplete: most lines are still classified Unknown. 26,213 point features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:2850 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

table:columns.name: address
table:columns.description: Street address of the service line. The rule requires the publicly accessible inventory to identify each service line by street address, or by another locational identifier where no address exists.

table:columns.name: location
table:columns.description: Street address or place description of the feature. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 26,213 rows, 26,135 distinct values.

table:columns.name: sensitivepop
table:columns.description: Whether the service line serves a sensitive population, such as a school or a child care facility. EPA directs systems to prioritise these for replacement.

table:columns.name: disadvantaged
table:columns.description: Whether the service line is in a neighbourhood the system has identified as disadvantaged, which affects prioritisation and funding eligibility.

table:columns.name: utilassetid
table:columns.description: Utility Asset ID. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 26,213 rows, 26,120 distinct values.

table:columns.name: utilmaterial
table:columns.description: Material of the **utility-owned** portion of the service line, from the main to the property line.

table:columns.name: everlead
table:columns.description: Whether the service line is known to have ever been lead, including a line since replaced.

table:columns.name: utilinstalldate
table:columns.description: Installation date of the utility-owned portion. A date after the local lead ban is itself accepted evidence of a non-lead line.

table:columns.name: utildiameter
table:columns.description: Diameter of the utility-owned portion. A line over two inches is accepted evidence of a non-lead line.

table:columns.name: utilsource
table:columns.description: Evidence the classification of the utility-owned portion rests on. The rule requires non-lead to rest on an evidence-based record, method or technique.

table:columns.name: utilverified
table:columns.description: Whether the utility-owned material was verified rather than inferred.

table:columns.name: utilverifmethod
table:columns.description: How the utility-owned material was verified.

table:columns.name: utilverifdate
table:columns.description: Utility Verification Date. Measured in the published file: Populated on 2% of 26,213 rows, 130 distinct values.

table:columns.name: utilstatus
table:columns.description: Classification of the utility-owned portion into the rule's four categories.

table:columns.name: utilnotes
table:columns.description: Utility Side Notes. Measured in the published file: Populated on 2% of 26,213 rows, 107 distinct values.

table:columns.name: custassetid
table:columns.description: Customer Asset ID. Measured in the published file: Populated on 0% of 26,213 rows, 1 distinct values.

table:columns.name: custmaterial
table:columns.description: Material of the **customer-owned** portion of the service line, from the property line to the building. The rule requires both portions to be inventoried even where the system owns neither.

table:columns.name: custinstalldate
table:columns.description: Installation date of the customer-owned portion.

table:columns.name: custdiameter
table:columns.description: Diameter of the customer-owned portion.

table:columns.name: custsource
table:columns.description: Evidence the classification of the customer-owned portion rests on.

table:columns.name: custverified
table:columns.description: Whether the customer-owned material was verified rather than inferred.

table:columns.name: custverifmethod
table:columns.description: How the customer-owned material was verified.

table:columns.name: custverifdate
table:columns.description: Customer Verification Date. Measured in the published file: Populated on 4% of 26,213 rows, 362 distinct values.

table:columns.name: custstatus
table:columns.description: Classification of the customer-owned portion into the rule's four categories.

table:columns.name: custnotes
table:columns.description: Customer Side Notes. Measured in the published file: Populated on 0% of 26,213 rows, 93 distinct values.

table:columns.name: bothsidesstatus
table:columns.description: Classification of the service line as a whole. This is the field that determines replacement obligation.

table:columns.name: leadconnector
table:columns.description: Whether a lead connector, also called a gooseneck or pigtail, is present. EPA defines a connector as a bendable segment of three feet or less; a documented lead segment longer than that is treated as a lead service line.

table:columns.name: leadsolder
table:columns.description: Whether lead solder is known to be present at the connection.

table:columns.name: otherfittings
table:columns.description: Other Fittings Containing Lead. Empty in all 26,213 rows of the published file.

table:columns.name: buildingtype
table:columns.description: Type of building the service line serves.

table:columns.name: pointofentry
table:columns.description: Whether a point-of-entry treatment device is installed.

table:columns.name: copperwithlead
table:columns.description: Whether the line is copper with lead solder, which is not a lead service line but is a lead source.

table:columns.name: samplingsite
table:columns.description: Whether this location is used as a tap sampling site for compliance monitoring.

table:columns.name: replacestatus
table:columns.description: Where the line stands in the replacement programme.

table:columns.name: scheddate
table:columns.description: Utility Side Scheduled Replacement Date. Empty in all 26,213 rows of the published file.

table:columns.name: utilreplacedate
table:columns.description: Date the utility-owned portion was replaced.

table:columns.name: custscheddate
table:columns.description: Customer Side Scheduled Replacement Date. Empty in all 26,213 rows of the published file.

table:columns.name: custreplacedate
table:columns.description: Customer Side Replacement Date. Empty in all 26,213 rows of the published file.

table:columns.name: replacereason
table:columns.description: Why the line is scheduled for replacement.

table:columns.name: custnotified
table:columns.description: Whether the customer has been notified, which the rule requires for a lead, galvanized-requiring-replacement or unknown line.

table:columns.name: notifydate
table:columns.description: Notification Date. Empty in all 26,213 rows of the published file.

table:columns.name: yearstructbuilt
table:columns.description: Year the building was constructed. Used as evidence where no installation record survives.

table:columns.name: CreationDate
table:columns.description: Timestamp when the row was created, from the geodatabase editor tracking. It records the database edit, not when the feature was built in the world.

table:columns.name: EditDate
table:columns.description: Timestamp when the row was last edited, from the geodatabase editor tracking. It records the database edit, not a change in the world.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
